{{Quote|Hey, can you hear something?''"<br />"''It sounds like a starfighter.''"<br />"''Hey&mdash;nobody gave you ''permission'' to fly through here!|Two B1 battle droids, just after clone trooper pilot Shooter crashes through one of them with his Z-95 starfighter|<ref name="Hotshot">{{TCWComicCite|6.54|Hotshot (comic story)}}</ref>}}
The '''clone Z-95 starfighter''', known more commonly as the '''clone Z-95 Headhunter''' or the '''Headhunter starfighter''' after its predecessor model, was a single-seater [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] developed by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] and [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporations]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A variant of the popular [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] Z-95 starfighter boasted speed and maneuverability on account of its sleek design. It was equipped with recessed [[Missile launcher/Legends|torpedo launchers]] and a pair of wingtip [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] allowed it to endure much damage, though it lacked a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. The model was specifically customized for the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], who often cross-trained in the Z-95 and another Incom/Subpro product, the heavy-duty [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]], due to the similarity of both [[Starship/Legends|starships]]' flight controls.

The Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] employed the Z-95 starfighter in several capacities, including escort and [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]] against enemy forces from the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], particularly at the lengthy [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. A number of clone trooper pilots such as [[Warthog/Legends|Warthog]] and [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk]] became adept in piloting the Z-95 in addition to other Republic combat craft. [[Squadron/Legends|Squadrons]] of Z-95 starfighters saw widespread use as part of [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] commanded by such [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Z-95 starfighters were also stationed at important Republic facilities like [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Republic military base]] and [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino's]] [[clone military education complex]]. Though Incom went on to produce further Z-95 variants, the clone starfighter was phased out after the Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|became]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which favored [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]' new [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Argh! I'm catching too much heat!|Warthog, maneuvering to avoid enemy fire in his Z-95 starfighter|<ref name="Escape from Kadavo">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref>}}
[[File:Z95TargetComp-CATH.png|thumb|left|250px|The targeting computer of a Z-95 starfighter]]
Developed from the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] product line by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]]/[[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporation]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] Z-95 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was manufactured during the regime of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], specifically tailored for use by the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. At 16.74 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, it slightly surpassed<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> its predecessor model, which was 11.8 meters long.<ref name="FF 136: Z-95">{{FactFile|136|HEA 1-2|Z-95 Headhunter}}</ref> Its sleek design facilitated maneuverability and agility, with a long nose extending from its single-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]]. It had a similar piloting control system as another Incom/Subpro product, the [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The cockpit's features included a [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]].<ref name="Crisis at the Heart">{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}}</ref> The starfighter's two [[Engine/Legends|engine]] units,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> a reduction from the Headhunter's original four,<ref name="FF 136: Z-95" /> were mounted on double wings and required regular maintenance.<ref name="FF-2014 7: Z-95" /> A [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] was positioned on each angular wingtip, leading to a wingspan of 18.13 meters.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Unlike the [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] weaponry of its forerunner model,<ref name="FF 136: Z-95" /> the Z-95 starfighter was equipped with more powerful, recessed [[Missile launcher/Legends|torpedo launchers]] to supplement its [[Laser/Legends|laser]] power. The torpedo launchers could be loaded with other types of ordnance as needed. Three feet extended from the underside of the craft as landing gear. The [[Starship/Legends|craft]] was equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] but lacked a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], as it was intended to be ferried into battle aboard larger [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="FF-2014 7: Z-95" /> Being integrated into the Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy]],<ref name="Darkness on Umbara" /> Z-95 starfighters commonly sported [[Color/Legends|white]] and crimson livery.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Role==
{{Quote|Hawk, we're gonna need air support once we're on the ground.''"<br />"''You'll have it, General. Me and the boys are ready to fly.|Anakin Skywalker and Hawk, the latter flying a clone Z-95 starfighter|<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />}}
[[File:HawkZ95Scipio-CATH.png|thumb|right|250px|Hawk and other clone trooper pilots fly Z-95 starfighters into battle at Scipio.]]
The clone Z-95 starfighter was intended for [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]], to be used by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] pilots of the Republic Navy. Due to its design, it amassed a reputation for speed and maneuverability, more so than its Incom/Subpro cousin, the ARC-170 starfighter.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Often deployed from [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] in [[Flight group/Legends|flight groups]] of three,<ref name="FF-2014 7: Z-95" /><ref name="Plan of Dissent">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref> members of the Z-95 class saw action against equally versatile enemy units, from [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] like the [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bomber]],<ref name="Darkness on Umbara" /> [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighter]], and [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighter]],<ref name="Plan of Dissent" /> to manually piloted [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighters]]. Z-95 starfighters were also used to escort bulkier craft during a battle, such as the Republic's [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] and [[Space gunship/Legends|space gunships]]. When not in use, Z-95 starfighters could be stored aboard large capital ship [[Transport/Legends|transports]] like the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]].<ref name="Darkness on Umbara" />

==History==
===Introduction on the battlefield===
{{Quote|Wolf Leader to Wolfpack, accelerate to attack speed.|Plo Koon, ordering a squadron of clone Z-95 starfighters into battle|<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />}}
Due to the widespread success of the Z-95 Headhunter line,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> which was manufactured by Incom/Subro Corporation and saw an upgraded model every production [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="FF 136: Z-95" /> the Galactic Republic commissioned a Headhunter variant specifically for its clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] pilots. The result was the clone Z-95 starfighter,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> which earned the name "clone Z-95 Headhunter,"<ref name="Explore: Plan of Dissent">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep409|text="Plan of Dissent" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> or more commonly the "Headhunter starfighter," after its base model.<ref name="Explore: Darkness on Umbara">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep407|text="Darkness on Umbara" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Although more maneuverable than the rugged ARC-170 starfighter&mdash;as well as another Republic model, the [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]]<ref name="FF-2014 7: Z-95" />&mdash;the Z-95 starfighter had controls similar to those of its fellow Incom/Subro product, enabling many clone trooper pilots to be cross-trained in both craft before joining the Republic Navy. Alongside other models like the ARC-170 and the V-19, the Z-95 starfighter was pressed into Republic service against the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> being introduced toward the end of [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="FF-2014 7: Z-95" /> It became a favorite of many clone troopers, earning a reputation for its performance and agility in combat.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /><ref name="TCW Magazine 22">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 22|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine'' 22]]</ref> Some clone pilots such as [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk]] and [[Warthog/Legends|Warthog]] became versatile enough to fly other Republic fighter models in addition to the Z-95.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" /><ref name="Encyclopedia: Warthog">{{SWE|characters|warthog|Warthog}}</ref>

[[File:BattleOverUmbara-DOU.png|thumb|left|250px|A Z-95 starfighter and other craft serve under Barriss Offee at the Battle of Umbara.]]
Z-95 starfighters were among a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led task force dispatched to [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|retake]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]],<ref name="Darkness on Umbara" /> whose [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] inhabitants had recently seceded from the Republic and joined the Confederacy.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Umbara">{{SWE|locations|umbara|Umbara}}</ref> Several Z-95 starfighters saw action alongside [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] under the command of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], who led an offensive against one of the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] in the Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] that was [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] Umbara. Once the Separatist [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] had fallen, the Republic's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] [[Space warfare/Legends|smashed through]] the enemy blockade and moved in to deploy their ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. Z-95 starfighters accompanied the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] ferrying [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] from an [[Unidentified Acclamator-class assault ship (Umbara)|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] and other transports to the planetary surface, providing cover from Umbaran starfighters dispatched by the [[Umbaran militia]]. The Z-95 escorts allowed much of the Republic invasion force to reach the surface. Headhunter starfighters also served with Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]], escorting him when he traveled via gunship to deliver new orders from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to Skywalker.<ref name="Darkness on Umbara" />

As the Republic targeted an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Unidentified Separatist supply ship/Legends|Separatist supply ship]] that was supplying the enemy defenses of Umbara's [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|capital city]], squadrons of Z-95 starfighters and BTL-B Y-wing starfighters were deployed against the much larger Separatist fleet. Engaging in dogfights with Umbaran and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] starfighters, the Z-95 and Y-wing squadrons took heavy losses until the intervention of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] and 501st troopers [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] and [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]], who commandeered Umbaran starfighters from a captured [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|Umbaran airbase]] and used them to eliminate the heavily guarded [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel/Legends|supply ship]]. The destruction of the [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]]<ref name="Plan of Dissent" /> led to an eventual Republic victory on Umbara, with the Umbaran militia forced to surrender control of their world.<ref name="Carnage of Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>

Later in the war, a three-member squadron from the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion's]] [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] flew Z-95 starfighters under Jedi General [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], who led a [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|starfighter assault]] on a [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|slave processing facility]] on the planet [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]]. Koon's assault was executed in tandem with an attack by Anakin Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Ahsoka Tano, who worked to liberate a number of [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] who were being [[Prisoner/Legends|held]] at the facility by the Separatist-backed [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]]. Flying their Z-95 starfighters alongside Koon's [[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Delta-7B interceptor]], Warthog and two fellow pilots challenged the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] defenses, which consisted of tower-mounted [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Autoturret/Legends|turrets]]. The starfighters' [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] were unable to eliminate the turrets due to their [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielding]]. Zygerrian-manned [[HH-87 Starhopper/Legends|HH-87 Starhoppers]] were soon launched against the Z-95 starfighters, sparking a chaotic air battle between the opposing squadrons. The Zygerrians were eventually defeated, with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Coburn/Legends|Coburn]] rescuing the Togruta slaves from the facility aboard an [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]].<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

===Sleek starfighter===
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Blue Group'', keep those fighters busy. ''Red Group'', form up behind me. We're commencing our ''attack'' on the ''main reactor''.|Anakin Skywalker, leading two squadrons of Z-95 starfighters into battle in the Enoth system|<ref name="Hotshot" />}}
[[File:BattleOfCatoNeimoidia-S.png|thumb|right|250px|Z-95 starfighters join Skywalker and Tano's air strike at Cato Neimoidia.]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 10: HMP">{{FactFile2014|10|HMP 1-2|HMP Droid Gunship}}</ref> several squadrons of Z-95 starfighters were stationed aboard [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] three-[[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] fleet of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] when it was [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|attacked]] by Confederate General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Bound for Rescue">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref> Clone trooper pilot [[Killer/Legends|Killer]]<ref name="Explore: Bound for Rescue">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep508|text="Bound for Rescue" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> was among the Z-95 pilots; his starfighter was shot down during the course of the battle.<ref name="Bound for Rescue" /> Following the destruction of his fleet, Kenobi received another complement of Z-95 starfighters when he transferred his surviving crew to his new [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]<ref name="A Necessary Bond">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref> in place of his fallen one,<ref name="Bound for Rescue" /> the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']].<ref name="Explore: Bound for Rescue" />

Z-95 starfighters also served with Anakin Skywalker aboard his ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer.<ref name="Sabotage">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref> Following [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence's]] discovery of a Separatist [[Unidentified Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] that was undergoing [[Unidentified Enoth system shipyards|construction]] in the [[Enoth system/Legends|Enoth system]], Skywalker brought along two units of Z-95 starfighters&mdash;[[Red Group (Galactic Republic)|Red Group]] and [[Blue Group]]&mdash;to eliminate the Separatist [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]]. Once forces under the command of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] had [[Battle of the Enoth system|destroyed]] the [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruiser's]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] on the [[Unidentified planet (Enoth system)|planet]] below, Skywalker had Blue Group engage the enemy [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] external Vulture droid defenses while he led Red Group into the nearly completed battleship. Errant clone Z-95 pilot [[Shooter]] sacrificed himself to breach the warship's main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]], imploding the heavy cruiser and completing their objective.<ref name="Hotshot" />

When Skywalker later [[Defense of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|responded]] to a Confederate invasion of the planet [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], clone trooper&ndash;manned Z-95 starfighters launched from Skywalker's flagship, providing protection for a landing force of LAAT/i gunships. After bypassing the Separatist fleet, they joined Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano in mounting an offensive on the enemy forces entrenched within the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Bridge city/Legends|bridge cities]]. Following the two Jedi's [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptors]] through the bridge [[City/Legends|cities]], several clone trooper pilots and their Z-95 starfighters were shot down by droid tri-fighters deployed from a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]. Skywalker and Tano were later recalled to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to investigate a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Sabotage" />

On Coruscant, a number of clone Z-95 starfighters were held in reserve at the [[Republic military base]], along with other starfighters and various matériel.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> Z-95 starfighters were also employed for aerial security at [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino's]] cloning facilities, particularly at the [[clone military education complex]].<ref name="Conspiracy">{{TCW|Conspiracy}}</ref> When Skywalker led a [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|campaign]] to capture the planet [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]] from the Confederacy, squadrons of Z-95 starfighters engaged the enemy starfighter squadrons around the massive [[Ringo Vinda space station/Legends|space station]] orbiting the planet. The battle lasted for several [[Standard day/Legends|days]], with Skywalker's 501st troops not making headway until the arrival of forces led by [[Twin/Legends|twin]] sister Jedi Generals [[Tiplee/Legends|Tiplee]] and [[Tiplar/Legends|Tiplar]].<ref name="The Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>

During Skywalker's invasion of the Confederate-occupied planet [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], the headquarters of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Clone Lieutenant]] Hawk and other clone trooper pilots flew Z-95 starfighters as escort for the 501st Legion's LAAT/i gunships. The Z-95 starfighters chased down the Separatist fleet's Vulture droids, creating a path for the LAAT/i gunships to reach the surface. Shortly thereafter, the Separatist naval forces retreated from Scipio, abandoning the ground forces that were already on the planet. Hawk and his comrades worked to obliterate the remaining droid starfighters that had been stationed outside Scipio's [[Main Vault/Legends|Main Vault]], helping to win the battle for the Republic.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />

===End of widespread use===
Although Incom Corporation developed further Z-95 Headhunter variants, including the [[AF-series]], use of the clone Z-95 starfighter ultimately petered out.<ref name="FF-2014 7: Z-95" /> After the Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|transitioned]] into the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the Empire phased out the clone starfighter in favor of the new [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]],<ref name="FF-2014 7: Z-95" /> a product of [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|A multi-purpose starfighter, the Z-95 has spawned countless variants, with the Republic making its own mark on the Headhunter's large production run with a clone trooper-specific model.|StarWars.com Encyclopedia entry for the clone Z-95 starfighter|<ref name="Encyclopedia" />}}
[[File:CloneZ-95Design-DoU.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Concept art for the Z-95 starfighter model]]
The clone Z-95 starfighter was developed for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and was first featured in the episodes "[[Darkness on Umbara]]"<ref name="Explore: Darkness on Umbara" /> and "[[Plan of Dissent]],"<ref name="Explore: Plan of Dissent" /> which aired with the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] in [[October]]<ref name="Explore: Darkness on Umbara" /> and [[November]] [[2011]], respectively.<ref name="Explore: Plan of Dissent" /> Since then, they have been featured in the fourth season episode "[[Escape from Kadavo]],"<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" /> as well as in episodes of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]]<ref name="Bound for Rescue" /><ref name="Explore: Sabotage">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep517|text="Sabotage" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> and the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]].<ref name="Conspiracy" /><ref name="The Unknown" /><ref name="Crisis at the Heart" /> The [http://www.starwars.com/explore/the-clone-wars/ep407/#!/about episode guide] for "Darkness on Umbara" on [[StarWars.com]] initially designated the craft as the "'''Z-85 Headhunter'''," implying that it was a variant of the Z-95 Headhunter, but this was later changed to "Headhunter starfighter."<ref name="Explore: Darkness on Umbara" /> The starfighter's [http://www.starwars.com/explore/encyclopedia/technology/z95headhunter entry] in the [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|StarWars.com Encyclopedia]] attributed its current designation and clarified that it was a variant of the mainstream Headhunter line.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

The starfighter was designed by the television series' crew with the intention of avoiding similarity to the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] from the [[original trilogy]] of ''[[Star Wars]]'' films. Instead, it more resembled artist [[Colin Cantwell]]'s original model for the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="Explore: Plan of Dissent" />

The Z-95 starfighter appears in the [[2013]] [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles (video game)|''LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles'']]. The game, which uses scenes from episodes of ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles]]'', features both a [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light Side]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] campaign. The Light Side campaign includes the Z-95 as a playable unit at the build hubs in certain missions. The starfighter is also one of the enemy units in the Dark Side bonus missions.<ref name="Yoda Chronicles">[[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles (video game)|''LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles'' video game]]</ref> A LEGO version also appears in the [[2014]] mobile game [[LEGO Star Wars: Microfighters (video game)|''LEGO Star Wars: Microfighters'']] during the Dark Side campaign as an enemy unit. It serves a role similar to that of the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]].<ref name="Microfighters">[[LEGO Star Wars: Microfighters (video game)|''LEGO Star Wars: Microfighters'' video game]]</ref>
